theming.tokenSuffix: Frontmatter keys ending in -dark are the :root[data-theme=dark] values of the same custom property; plate has no dark value (it stays white).

components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:24px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:999px;font:500 13px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--border, #dedee6);background:var(--surface-2, #eeeef3);color:var(--text-2, #5b5b68);transition:background 160ms,color 160ms;}.ds-chip svg{width:16px;height:16px;}.ds-chip-processing{background:var(--accent-soft, #ecebff);border-color:var(--accent-line, #cfccfa);color:var(--accent, #4b44d6);}.ds-chip-finished{background:var(--success-soft, #e9f6ee);border-color:var(--success-line, #bfe3cc);color:var(--success, #1d7a3e);}.ds-chip-draft{background:var(--warning-soft, #fdf3e1);border-color:var(--warning-line, #efd6a6);color:var(--warning, #8f5a00);}.ds-chip-failed,.ds-chip-recording{background:var(--recording-soft, #fdecec);border-color:var(--recording-line, #f3c4c4);color:var(--recording, #c92a2a);}.ds-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;animation:ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;}.ds-spin{animation:ds-rot 1.4s linear infinite;}@keyframes ds-pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}@keyframes ds-rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dot,.ds-spin{animation:none}}

components.name: Worked Example and Callouts
components.description: Notes cards: indigo Problem box, unboxed steps on an indigo path, green Answer box, then Key idea (blue) and Watch out (amber) callouts led by a bold coloured label.
components.html:
Problem: Express 3x² + 18x − 1 in the form a(x + b)² + c.

Step 1: Factor out 3 from the first two terms.

3(x² + 6x) − 1

Step 2: Halve the 6 and square it.

3[(x + 3)² − 9] − 1

Answer: 3(x + 3)² − 28

Key idea: halve the coefficient of x, then square it.
Watch out: multiply the −9 by 3 before adding the constant.
components.css: .ds-notes{font:400 17px/1.7 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--text, #17171c);max-width:68ch;}.ds-notes p{margin:0;}.ds-card-problem,.ds-card-answer{margin:16px 0;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--accent-line, #cfccfa);background:var(--accent-soft, #ecebff);}.ds-card-problem strong{color:var(--accent, #4b44d6);}.ds-card-answer{border-color:var(--success-line, #bfe3cc);background:var(--success-soft, #e9f6ee);}.ds-card-answer strong{color:var(--success, #1d7a3e);}.ds-step{position:relative;padding:4px 0 20px 30px;}.ds-step strong{color:var(--accent, #4b44d6);}.ds-step::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:4px;top:13px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent, #4b44d6);background:var(--bg, #f6f6f9);box-sizing:border-box;z-index:1;}.ds-step::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:9px;top:13px;bottom:-13px;width:1px;background:var(--accent-line, #cfccfa);}.ds-step:has(+ .ds-card-answer)::after{display:none;}.ds-callout{margin:16px 0;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid;font:400 17px/1.7 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--text, #17171c);max-width:68ch;}.ds-key{background:var(--info-soft, #eaf0fd);border-color:var(--info-line, #c4d4f6);}.ds-key strong{color:var(--info, #2457c5);}.ds-warn{background:var(--warning-soft, #fdf3e1);border-color:var(--warning-line, #efd6a6);}.ds-warn strong{color:var(--warning, #8f5a00);}

components.css: .ds-ribbon{font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;padding-top:28px;}.ds-track{position:relative;height:22px;}.ds-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:6px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-strong, #c9c9d4) 0 1px,transparent 1px 10%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-strong, #c9c9d4);}.ds-mark{position:absolute;top:0;width:10px;height:18px;margin-left:-5px;padding:0;border-radius:3px 3px 1px 1px;border:2px solid var(--accent, #4b44d6);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background 160ms;}.ds-done{background:var(--accent, #4b44d6);}.ds-unverified{border-color:var(--warning, #8f5a00);background:var(--warning, #8f5a00);}.ds-mark:hover,.ds-mark:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-2px);}.ds-mark:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #4b44d6);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-tip{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--text, #17171c);color:var(--bg, #f6f6f9);font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;}.ds-scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--text-2, #5b5b68);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

narrative.northStar: The stage belongs to the notes
narrative.overview:
Iris is a quiet working tool around a reading column. The shell (top bar, library, rail, recorder) is an Operate surface: dense, neutral, set in a 14px system sans, with hairlines doing the work cards and shadows would do elsewhere. The notes are a Read surface: 17px text at 1.7 line height in a 68-character column that never moves while results stream in. Progress is told in plain sentences in a 300px side rail, never as metrics or stage names stacked above the notes.

Colour is cool, lightly indigo-tinted neutral in two layers: a white (or near-black) content surface on a slightly darker ground, and a second neutral layer (`surface-2`) for the top bar, rail, table headers and code. One indigo accent carries action, links, focus and the current step. Red, green, amber and blue each mean exactly one kind of state. Light and dark themes differ only in token values; figures stay on white plates in both, because redraws and screenshots are drawn on white.

The one decorative element is the session ribbon: the session's length as a ticked line, with each figure pinned where it was shown.
keyCharacteristics: System UI sans throughout; no web fonts. KaTeX keeps its own math fonts.
Two type sizes do most of the work: 14px for the app, 17px for the notes.
Flat, hairline-bordered surfaces; one shadow, reserved for the dialog and the recording bar.
One indigo accent; state colours used only for their state, always with words.
Light, dark and system themes from one token set, switched by `data-theme` on `<html>`.
Calm motion: 160–200ms state transitions, no page-load choreography, all off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo means "you can act here" or "this is where you are": action, link, focus, the current step, the selected tab. It is never used as decoration or as a background fill for whole regions.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red is recording, failure and deletion; green is finished; amber is draft and unverified; blue is the Key idea callout. No state colour borrows another's job, and none ever appears without a word that says the same thing.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Themes differ only in custom-property values. Components reference tokens, never literal colours, so a new component is dark-mode ready by construction.

rules.name: The White Plate Rule
rules.body: Figures sit on `plate` white in both themes. Never invert, tint or dim a figure to suit dark mode; it would misrepresent what was shown.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: The app is set at 14px; the notes at 17px on 1.7. New UI uses the app scale; anything that is the user's content uses the notes scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every timer, timestamp, duration, count and percentage uses tabular numerals (`.num`), so live values never jitter.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, headings and buttons are sentence case. Weights are 400, 500 and 600 (300 only for the recorder clock).

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px `border` line or a tonal step. A new panel, card or row gets a hairline, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: 6px if you can press it, 10px if it holds things. Pills are reserved for status.

dos: **Do** keep the notes column fixed at 68ch and 17px/1.7; partial results fill in place without moving what is already there.
**Do** say state in words first: every chip, badge and step carries a label, with colour and icon as secondary signals.
**Do** use the global focus ring (2px `accent`, 2px offset) on every interactive element, including whole-row links and the drop zone.
**Do** use `.num` tabular numerals for every clock, timestamp, count and percentage.
**Do** put figures on the white plate with their caption, source time and provenance badge.
**Do** add new colours as a light and dark token pair, checked to WCAG AA in both themes.
donts: **Don't** add shadows to cards, panels or rows; the Float shadow belongs to the dialog and the recording bar only.
**Don't** put metric tiles, cost cards or pipeline stage names above the notes; progress lives in the rail as plain sentences, with stage names behind Details.
**Don't** use indigo or a state colour as decoration, or a state colour for a different state.
**Don't** add web fonts, display faces, ALL-CAPS labels or eyebrow text above headings.
**Don't** hard-code a colour in a component, or invert or tint figures in dark mode.
**Don't** add a second decorative element; the session ribbon is the only one.
